title: Holographic Network and Traversable Parallel Universe
abstract: We investigate how different conformal field theories connect through holographic networks using Gauss-Bonnet gravity. We prove that the junction condition on the Net-brane leads to conservation laws at network nodes and examine gravitational stability constraints. The work explores entropy proposals for these networks and analyzes two-point functions across network edges. A key finding is that AdS/NCFT provides a natural way to envision traversable parallel universes that have different geometries and physical laws. Unlike traversable wormholes, the parallel universe model satisfies all energy conditions.
key_claims: Junction conditions on Net-branes give conservation laws at holographic network nodes
AdS/NCFT holographic network supports traversable parallel universe with different physical laws
Parallel universe model satisfies all energy conditions (unlike traversable wormholes)
Two-point functions computed across network edges
Relevant to multi-CFT holographic tensor network extensions of MERA
